p: finished all his house: After he had built the temple.
of the forest of Lebanon: Because of the beauty of the place, and great abundance of cedar trees that went into the building of it, it was compared to mount Lebanon.
against light in three ranks: There were as many and like proportion on the one side as the other, and at every end even three in a row one above another.
them: Before the pillars of the house.
for the throne where he might: For his house which was at Jerusalem.
the coping: Which were rests and stays for the beams to lie on.
above were costly stones: From the foundation upward.
both for the inner court of: As the Lord's house was built so was this, only the great court of Solomon's house was uncovered.
he was filled with wisdom: Thus when God will have his glory set forth, he raises up men, and gives them excellent gifts for the accomplishment of the same, Ex 31:2,3.
lily work in the porch: As was seen commonly wrought in costly porches.
porch of the temple: Which was in the inner court between the temple and the oracle.
Jachin: That is, he will stablish, that is, his promise toward this house.
Boaz: That is, in strength: meaning the power of it will continue.
sea: So called for the size of the vessel.
baths: Bath and ephah seem to be one measure, Eze 45:11 a bath contains about 5 gallons.
mouth of it within the chapiter: The mouth of the great base or frame entered into the chapiter, or pillar that bore up the cauldron.
compass of half a cubit high: Which was called the pillar, chapiter or small base, in which the cauldron stood.
ten lavers of brass: To keep waters for the use of the sacrifices.
house eastward over against the south: That is, of the temple or sanctuary.
Hiram made to king Solomon for: By this name also Hiram the king of Tyrus was called.
altar of gold: This was done according to the form that the Lord prescribed to Moses in Exodus.
and the snuffers: Some take this for some musical instrument.
